requirements.evidence: Locale/name: .env.example:1,7 (APP_NAME=PegaFila, APP_LOCALE=pt_BR) and phpunit.xml:22-24 pin all three values. Theme: config/mail.php:130 'theme' => env('MAIL_MARKDOWN_THEME', 'pegafila'); pegafila.css:240-247 '.button-primary { background-color: #0f7490; ... }' on the action button. Lang: lang/pt_BR.json:559 "Reset your password": "Redefina sua senha", :803 "Verify your email address": "Verifique seu endereço de e-mail". Flow: routes/web.php:16-29 guest group with all four names and 'throttle:6,1' on password.email; PasswordResetLinkController.php:25-31 ignores the broker status and always returns back()->with('status', __(Password::RESET_LINK_SENT)); NewPasswordController.php:31-35 validates token/email/PasswordRule::min(8)->letters()->mixedCase()->numbers() + confirmed, :39-47 saves password, rotates remember_token, fires PasswordReset, :50 redirect('/'). Reset form has a single email input (reset-password.blade.php:22). Verification: routes/web.php:31-33 auth+signed+throttle, VerifyEmailController uses EmailVerificationRequest (403 on id/hash mismatch) and redirect('/'). Could not confirm from the diff that the remaining body strings exist for the installed Laravel version, but the tests assert them.

conventions.evidence: Tests ship with the change, CHANGELOG.md:12 updated under [Unreleased], PHPDoc on every public controller method, {{ }} escaping in views. Deviation: NewPasswordController.php:31-35 validates three fields inline although conventions ask for a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields. Views use plain unstyled HTML rather than Bulma markup (acceptable given 'any markup' and layouts out of scope).

security.evidence: Reset routes behind 'guest' and password.email throttled (routes/web.php:16,21); no account enumeration (PasswordResetLinkController.php:31 always same status); strong password rules (NewPasswordController.php:34); remember_token rotated (:42); verification uses signed URL + EmailVerificationRequest authorize (id/hash) + auth + throttle; all view output escaped with {{ }} (reset-password.blade.php:19-22). No mass-assignment exposure (forceFill on trusted values only).

tests.evidence: AuthEmailsTest.php covers config pins, theme file, both mails' subject/button/body/sub-copy/brand/color and absence of English sub-copy (:10-40, :42-56). PasswordResetTest.php covers form rendering, existing vs non-existing e-mail returning the same status (:21-43), invalid e-mail, success with hash check + remember_token rotation + event (:67-90), weak password (:92-104), invalid token (:106-117). EmailVerificationTest.php covers success, hash mismatch, other user's id, unsigned link (all 403). Missing: throttle on password.email, password confirmation mismatch, and an assertion that the VerifyEmail action URL points at the verification.verify route.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Laravel's Password broker, ResetPassword/VerifyEmail notifications and EmailVerificationRequest instead of hand-rolling; controllers are short (NewPasswordController ~40 lines). The 297-line pegafila.css is a copy of the default theme with the brand color, which is required because a custom theme replaces default.css entirely.

readability.evidence: Clear controller names and small methods (PasswordResetLinkController.php:15-31, VerifyEmailController.php:15-20); descriptive test names (e.g. 'the same status is returned when the e-mail address does not exist'); no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: All files serve the task: env/phpunit pins, mail config + theme, lang entries, the four reset routes and verification route, two views, controllers, tests and CHANGELOG. No login/registration/notice/resend, layouts, ui.php, SCSS/JS or Docker changes. app/Models/User.php:15 'implements MustVerifyEmail' is closely related to the verification mail.

issues.explanation: Three validated fields with non-trivial rules are validated inline, while conventions require a Form Request once rules go beyond one or two fields.
No test covers the throttle:6,1 limit on password.email or a password_confirmation mismatch, both explicit in the task.
The verification mail test does not assert that the action URL is built from the verification.verify route (/email/verify/{id}/{hash}).
Implementing MustVerifyEmail makes the Registered event auto-send verification mail, a behavior change not strictly required by this task (though aligned with it).
Standalone HTML pages with no Bulma classes; acceptable since the task allows any markup and layouts are out of scope, but will need restyling later.

review.summary: The change adds pt-BR/PegaFila locale pins, a custom 'pegafila' mail theme with #0f7490 on the action button, the missing subject translations, a guest-only throttled password-reset flow that never reveals account existence, and a signed verification route using EmailVerificationRequest, all with meaningful feature tests. It meets every requirement and contract item securely and with minimal code; only minor gaps remain (inline validation instead of a Form Request, no throttle/confirmation-mismatch tests), so I would approve with nits.
